body: Reproduced. Only happens if timestamp behavior is added. The error happens inside of PHP so it is hard to figure out the cause...

the same also happens also with the AttributeBehavior.
are they any news how to fix this issue or when it will be resolved?

what i find interesting is that if add this one line it works, so how can something similar be done without using print_r?
(just above the array_multisort call in the BaseArrayHelper Class)

```
print_r($args, true);
call_user_func_array('array_multisort', $args);
```

Or better using the BaseVarDumper with a min depth of 2 before adding the array to the args.

```
BaseVarDumper::dumpAsString($array, 2);
$args[] = &$array;
```

Of course this cannot be the solution.

Problem can be solved by adding `__toString` into `yii\base\Object` and adding `$args[] = SORT_STRING;` after https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/helpers/BaseArrayHelper.php#L448
But this solution good only for objects, not for all cases.

The same problem is with `Zelenin\yii\behaviors\Slug`. Also, i've noticed that this error occurs only with a certain amount of entries in the array - on small arrays everything goes through fine.
Tried adding the `print_r`, this also prevents the error from happening. My PHP version is `5.5.9-1ubuntu4.13`.

@beowulfenator Just to be sure: I can somewhat recall having this error message on a dataset with a left join, that contained null values (non-existing records for the relation), and then performing array_multisort() on this array. Like I said, just to be sure, could this be the case with your issue as well?  (Your "on small arrays everything goes fine" reminded me about this issue I had, because my small datasets did not contain these null values)

Wow! Thanks, @niektenhoopen, this is exactly my case. The models do have some null attributes and removing them seems to fix the problem. UPDATE: well, it doesn't solve it completely, but at least i see it influences the result somehow.

I resolve this using http://www.php.net/manual/en/function.array-multisort.php#113445 .

To reproduce bug, just try sort two identical ActiveRecord models
